class Pattern extends RegExp {}
const pattern = new Pattern('a', 'g');
pattern.lastIndex = 1;
const copy = RegExp(pattern);
console.log(copy.exec('aa')?.index, pattern.lastIndex, copy instanceof Pattern);
const standard = /a/g;
console.log(RegExp(standard) === standard);
let reads = 0;
Object.defineProperty(standard, 'constructor', { configurable: true, get() {
  reads++;
  return Pattern;
} });
console.log(RegExp(standard) === standard, reads);
console.log(new RegExp(standard) === standard, RegExp(standard, 'i').flags, reads);
Object.defineProperty(standard, 'constructor', { get() { throw new Error('constructor read'); } });
try { RegExp(standard); } catch (error) { if (error instanceof Error) console.log(error.message); }
